text:
maria: Heads-up — Support holiday blackout is scheduled for Dec 24–27. We keep getting PTO swap requests last minute and it blocks ticket coverage. Proposal: allow manager auto-approval for PTO swaps in the blackout window if (1) a cross-trained backup is assigned, (2) the swap is requested >=72h before the shift, and (3) the replacement's manager explicitly ACKs. Also want a simple coverage queue (Confluence page + calendar) and a lightweight Slack command to submit swaps (/pto-swap). Thoughts?

sam: Sounds good. Two quick q's: how do we handle overlapping swaps where multiple people want the same backup? First-come wins? :thinking_face: 

josh: Agree with maria. For support we also need SLA gating — if the shift is a critical on-call slot, auto-approve should be blocked. Can we mark shifts as "no-auto" in the rota?

tara: +1 on the 72h rule. From policy POV we'll need an audit trail for approvals and the replacement manager's sign-off. We can leverage the `/pto-swap` command to capture the metadata (requester, original shift, replacement, managers). Link to current PTO policy: https://redwood.internal/hr/pto-policy (for reference).

cleo: I can spin up the Confluence coverage queue and calendar. Proposal for simple page layout: table with Date | Shift | Owner | Replacement | Manager OK | Notes. I'll add a section for "no-auto" flagged shifts. Want me to draft a template?

sam: Draft would be great. For the Slack command, example payload:```/pto-swap @sam -> @alex 2025-12-24 09:00-17:00 reason: family``` Command should validate conflict and require both managers to confirm if within blackout window. If 72h passed and conflict, it goes to manual review.

josh: Also: retention of these swap records for 1 year for audits. And an alert to the oncall rotation owner when a swap affects coverage.

tara: We can do 1 year retention in HR logs. For notifications we can hook into the rota bot to post `@rotation-owner` when a swap is accepted. I'll coordinate with eng-infra on the bot change.

hr-bot: automated: Created placeholder Confluence page "Support Coverage Queue (holiday blackout)" — cleo to populate. Swap command stub added to dev queue.

maria: Great — action items: 1) cleo: draft Confluence template and calendar (ETA: EOD tomorrow) 2) sam/josh: define "no-auto" shift list and SLA gating rules (ETA: 48h) 3) tara: confirm audit + retention language and add to PTO policy (ETA: 72h) 4) infra: add validation + notification hooks for `/pto-swap` (I'll ping eng-infra). If everyone ok I'll post final process and a short how-to for managers. :white_check_mark:

sam: OK by me. Will start listing no-auto slots now.

josh: 👍 will add notes on on-call vs coverage differences.

cleo: Draft done — uploading in 30m. Will add the table and calendar invites.

tara: Thanks — once we have the draft i'll add the policy blurb and the audit checklist.

maria: Perfect — thanks all. I'll close this thread once we have the Confluence link and the `/pto-swap` PR. :eyes:
